exposure: inhaled highly selective phosphodiesterase 4 inhibitor (GSK256066) at low (iPDE1) and high (iPDE10) doses
cohort: The study included 21 preterm lambs in a triple-hit model of Ureaplasma-induced chorioamnionitis, prematurity, and mechanical ventilation.
finding: High doses of an inhaled PDE4 inhibitor impaired oxygenation during mechanical ventilation and decreased the budding of secondary septae in the preterm lung, suggesting altered alveologenesis.
